subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

An anthology of poems on childhood is being written by her.

options.text: She is writing an anthology of poems on childhood.
She has been writing an anthology of poems on childhood.
She has written an anthology of poems on childhood.
She will be written an anthology of poems on childhood.

solution:
The correct answer is **'****She is writing an anthology of poems on childhood.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Present Continuous Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Present Continuous Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 __
 
• *Esha is singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• A song is being sung by Esha.* *(Passive Voice)

 ​
 
 
 
 

Correct Answer__: *She is writing an anthology of poems on childhood.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, the sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: *He reads a novel. *(Active Voice)

 * A novel is read by him. *(Passive Voice)*​*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Present Continuous Tense और **Passive**** V**oice में है।
 
• Present Continuous Tense को Active voice से Passive voice या Passive voice से Active voice में बदलने का नियम:
 
 
• Object और Subject को एक दूसरे के साथ बदलें, यानी Active Voice का object, Passive Voice का subject बन जाती है।
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + is/am/are + v1 + ing + object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha is singing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• A song is being sung by Esha.* *(Passive Voice)
